== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Grimtaash (Japanese)|Grimtaash]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/sputman1021/imagegallery/47850 Japanese A New Hope PSA showcase], PSA certificate 160117590.

Crop rectangle <code>(153, 608, 1333, 2280)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>982a0641d81e2edfff20cf3209d96d57f7429078ec385dede3adcee9cd0452ed</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
